- If it ends with \(D\), the preceding part can be any valid pattern for \(n-1\) houses: \(a_{n-1}\) ways.
- If it ends with \(ND\), the part before that can be any valid pattern for \(n-2\) houses: \(a_{n-2}\) ways.
- If it ends with \(NND\), the part before that can be any valid pattern for \(n-3\) houses: \(a_{n-3}\) ways.

Thus the recurrence is
\[
a_n = a_{n-1} + a_{n-2} + a_{n-3}.
\]

Initial conditions (base cases):
- \(a_0 = 1\) (empty street, one way: do nothing).
- \(a_1 = 2\) ( deliver or not deliver: “D”, “N”).
- \(a_2 = 4\) (orrect patterns: “DD”, “DN”, “ND”, “NN”).

\[

a_3 &= a_2 + a_1 + a_0 = 4 + 2 + 1 = 7,\\
a_4 &= a_3 + a_2 + a_1 = 7 + 4 + 2 = 13,\\
a_5 &= a_4 + a_3 + a_2 = 13 + 7 + 4 = 24,\\
a_6 &= a_5 + a_4 + a_3 = 24 + 13 + 7 = 44,\\
a_7 &= a_6 + a_5 + a_4 = 44 + 24 + 13 = 81,\\
a_8 &= a_7 + a_6 + a_5 = 81 + 44 + 24 = 149,\\
a_9 &= a_8 + a_7 + a_6 = 149 + 81 + 44 = 274,\\
a_{10} &= a_9 + a_8 + a_7 = 274 + 149 + 81 = 504.
\end{aligned}
\]
